scope: Proposition 11.1 (Global recovery of the original exterior) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 93. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the connected nonextremal equality hypotheses, the original (Ω, g, K, E) admits a global orientation-preserving smooth space- like embedding, including its boundary, into the regular future horizon extension of the Reissner– Nordström–Tangherlini exterior Gm,Q = −f(r) dT2 + f(r)−1 dr2 + r2 σk, f(r) = 1 − 2m rk−1 + Q2 r2k−2 , (11.1) with Faraday form Fm,Q = cnQr−k dT ∧ dr, cn = √ k(k − 1) 2 . (11.2) It induces exactly g, K, E with K(U, V ) = Gm,Q(∇U N, V ) and E♭ = c−1 n ι∗(iN Fm,Q), and ι∗Fm,Q = 0. Its boundary is a full smooth future horizon section if u|S > 0, and is the bifurcation sphere if u|S = 0. The future normal and all induced data extend smoothly to the boundary; the end approaches the corresponding spatial infinity. Moreover µm = Jm = 0 on the original exterior.
